title: [VIC] Rod Laver, Margaret Crt. + John Cain Arena Australian Open Tix from $29, 4-5pm Every Thursday in Nov & Dec @ Ticketmaster
body:
Deal: [VIC] Rod Laver, Margaret Crt. + John Cain Arena Australian Open Tix from $29, 4-5pm Every Thursday in Nov & Dec @ Ticketmaster

You'll know when they go on sale, in 4 days.

Good luck with the tickets. They're just available so the organisers can say we had tickets from $29, when people start to complain about the prices.
